::: {#weekly-content role="region" aria-label="Weekly content schedule"}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-format: png

source("R/render_weekly_content_table.R")

weekly_content <- read_weekly_content_csv("data/weekly_content.csv")

semester_breaks <- read.csv(
  "data/semester_breaks.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

render_weekly_content_table(
  weekly_content,
  semester_breaks = semester_breaks,
  caption = FALSE
)
```

:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const scheduleTable = document.querySelector("#weekly-content table");
  if (scheduleTable) {
    scheduleTable.setAttribute("aria-label", "Weekly content schedule");
  }
});
</script>
